To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the overlap of domain name and directory name is a good feature for a MetaSearch for navigational queries.
the MetaSearch algorithms should be different for informational queries and for navigational queries.
overlap of a document name and overlap of a domain name are more effective in finding a navigational query result than the overlap of a directory name.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a MetaSearch algorithm which is suitable for a navigational search.
the development of a MetaSearch algorithm that is effective for navigational queries as well as informational queries.
the problem of how to use the MetaSearch algorithm for a navigational queries.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the MetaSearch algorithm for informational queries is to give a high score to a overlapped document, while the MetaSearch algorithm to navigational queries is to give the higher score to the domain or the directory name.
MetaSearch is effective for both navigational and informational queries.
the overlap of documents should be emphasized in MetaSearch for informational queries, while the overlap of domain or directory names should be emphasized in navigational queries.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the overlap of a directory name and a domain name is an effective feature for a MetaSearch algorithm of navigational queries.
the overlap of domain or directory names is more effective for navigational queries than for informational queries.
the MetaSearch algorithm is effective for both informational and navigational queries, and the MetaSearch algorithm can be used as a general purpose search engine.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we should consider the importance of the overlap of domain or directory names in a MetaSearch algorithm.
a MetaSearch algorithm should consider the overlap of documents, domain names, or directory names depending on query types.
the performance of a navigational query is not affected by the overlap of document titles.
